plan.flow: A shared, responsive feedlot operations workspace for one user population. The persistent menu takes users from live lot and pen performance through cattle imports, inventory, rations, feeding and weights, then to reports and a project/demo area. Dense, filterable operational tables carry the marketplace field’s scannable catalog pattern into feedlot records without turning the product into a storefront; costs are easy to compare, and real crop or cattle photographs appear only where they help identify the item or animals.

At right, show the signed-in user Mara Ortega, Feed manager, with a compact initials avatar “MO” to the left of her name; all users see these same product areas and controls. plan.sample:
Facility: Cedar Draw Feedlot. One time zone for every record and report: America/Denver. Sample date for the workspace: 23 Apr 2025. People: Mara Ortega — Feeding department, Feed manager; Eli Chen — Inventory department, Inventory coordinator; Diego Ruiz — Cattle department, Yard lead. The shared shell may show Mara Ortega and her role; use initials rather than a portrait. All three people use the same product areas and controls, with no role-dependent restrictions.
Pens and capacity: P-04 capacity 150, currently 116 head (L-241: 60; L-242: 56), 34 open. P-02 capacity 120, currently 72 head (L-239), 48 open. Total occupied capacity is 188/270 across two pens. Lot L-243 has 24 head linked to PO-5831 but no pen, so those animals are not available for pen operations. Total head in these accepted lots is 212 (188 penned plus 24 awaiting a pen). Incoming records that are pending mapping or blocked by capacity are not included in those totals.
Lots: L-239, Angus steers, 72 head in P-02; received 20 Dec 2024 at 650 lb, latest weight 1,010 lb on 21 Apr 2025, target 1,350 lb, measured ADG 2.95 lb/day, 158,112 as-fed feed lb through latest reading, FCR 6.10, feed cost $0.93/lb gain, projected market date 14 Aug 2025. L-241, Angus–Hereford steers, 60 head in P-04; received 12 Jan 2025 at 612 lb, latest weight 842 lb on 20 Apr, target 1,350 lb, measured ADG 2.35 lb/day, 82,320 as-fed feed lb through latest reading, FCR 5.96, feed cost $0.91/lb gain, projected market date 22 Nov 2025. L-242, Charolais-cross heifers, 56 head in P-04; received 2 Feb 2025 at 548 lb, latest weight 706 lb on 20 Apr, target 1,250 lb, measured ADG 2.05 lb/day, 60,368 as-fed feed lb through latest reading, FCR 6.82, feed cost $1.04/lb gain, projected market date 10 Jan 2026. L-243, Angus–Hereford steers, 24 head, split from PO-5831 line 1; received 12 Jan at 612 lb, no pen and no measured ADG, target 1,350 lb and configured default ADG 3.0 lb/day. Its forecast uses that default and it remains unavailable for pen operations.
Import records: PO-5831 line 1, source file `april_cattle_po.csv`, vendor Red Basin Cattle Co., origin Red Basin Ranch, 84 head at $1,470/head ($123,480 total), 612 lb average, Angus–Hereford steers, age 16 months; split 60 to L-241/P-04 and 24 to L-243/no pen. PO-5840 line 1, source file `april_cattle_po.csv`, vendor Mesa Valley Cattle Co., origin Mesa Valley Ranch, 56 head at $1,338/head ($74,928 total), 548 lb average, Charolais-cross heifers, age 14 months; mapped to L-242/P-04. REC-8843 from `april_receiving.csv` repeats the PO-5831 84-head record and is a duplicate. REC-8844 from `april_receiving.csv`, vendor Juniper Ridge Cattle, origin Juniper Ridge Ranch, 18 Hereford-cross steers at $1,290/head, 522 lb average, 13 months; pending lot mapping. REC-8845 from `april_receiving.csv`, vendor High Mesa Livestock, origin High Mesa Ranch, 40 Angus steers at $1,410/head, 590 lb average, 15 months; assignment to P-04 is blocked because 116+40 exceeds the pen capacity of 150.
Feed inventory at 23 Apr: Yellow corn, $0.112/lb, 680,000 lb; Alfalfa hay, $0.145/lb, 390,000 lb; Soybean meal, $0.238/lb, 170,000 lb; Mineral premix, $0.640/lb, 42,000 lb. A 12,000 lb corn receipt was posted 18 Apr. Actual alfalfa hay wastage of 116 lb was entered separately on 22 Apr. Estimated wastage ratio for projections is 4.2%. Occupied pens consume 2,920 lb/day at current plans: P-04 116 head × 14 lb/head = 1,624 lb; P-02 72 head × 18 lb/head = 1,296 lb. With 4.2% estimated wastage, annual projected balances are approximately 69,689 lb corn, 56,831 lb hay, 36,732 lb soybean meal and 8,683 lb mineral premix.
Rations: Grower 1 contains 55% corn, 30% alfalfa hay, 12% soybean meal and 3% mineral premix; cost $0.15286/lb; crude protein 13.8%, TDN 70%, NDF 24%, energy 1.51 Mcal/lb; intended for 548–900 lb growing cattle. Finisher 2 contains 65% corn, 20% hay, 12% soybean meal and 3% mineral premix; cost $0.14956/lb; intended for 900–1,350 lb finishers. One optimizer candidate is 57% corn, 28% hay, 12% soybean meal and 3% mineral premix, at $0.15220/lb; it is a suggestion until explicitly selected and saved.
Plans: 22 Apr 2025 P-04, Grower 1, 116 head, 14 lb/head/day, 1,624 lb, Completed. 19 Apr 2025 P-02, Grower 1, 72 head, 18 lb/head/day, 1,296 lb, Completed. The 23 Apr P-04 plan preview is 1,624 lb, split L-241 840 lb and L-242 784 lb. noScreen.reason: FeedToGainCalculator.calculate is a callable public method, not a user-facing page. Expose it from the web app’s public calculation module and validate its supplied receiving, feeding, weight, headcount and target-weight inputs with automated tests; the Project & demo page may show a worked example of its returned figures.

system.digest: Use 8px corners on outer panels and 6px on nested fields and buttons. Edge panels with a 1px rule and no shadow. Keep spacing on a 4px base, using 8, 12, 16, 24, and 32px steps. Set the first heading to 30px/650 (26px on phones), the second to 22px/650, and the third to 17px/600. Set body copy to 16px with 24px leading; dense table text may be 14px. Make table rows 48px tall on wide layouts and 56px on phones, divided by a 1px horizontal rule. Make filled and outlined buttons 44px tall and fields 44px tall with labels above and a visible focus outline. Show each status with its explicit text and a thin matching outline, never color alone. Crop real identifying photos to 4:3 around a centered subject and reuse the same photograph for a recurring person; keep titles in a narrow left column beside a broad data region.

motion.signature: Filtered table rows settle with a 160ms opacity-and-8px transform entrance, staggered by 50ms for up to six rows (`--dur-quick: 160ms`; `translateY(8px)`).
motion.ambient: A live performance dot breathes from 0.96 to 1 opacity on an 8s ease-in-out loop (`animation: status-breathe 8s ease-in-out infinite`).
